purpose: Records, transparently, every experiment-apparatus file changed after the original 2026-09-17 freeze, and why. The DECISION RULES - the artefacts that determine verdicts - are unchanged and still match their original hashes.

changes_and_reasons.reason: The three new coverage scenarios needed per-rep randomisation. This breaks the original manifest hash and is disclosed here rather than concealed; verify_frozen.sh will flag it.

changes_and_reasons.change: B3_pdv_congestion rewritten: tc netem -> tbf bottleneck + competing non-PTP background traffic; impairment failure is now fatal and logged.
changes_and_reasons.reason: DEFECT. This kernel has no sch_netem; the old line swallowed the failure with 2>/dev/null||true, so B3 injected NOTHING and was a mislabelled baseline for the ENTIRE prior campaign. Verified: its PDV was identical to baseline (sd 36.0ms vs 35.5ms). After the fix, Sync PDV rises from 0.07ms to 5.6-857ms.
